summary.text: Richard Nelson is a Republican state representative from Orleans-1 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Richard Nelson assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, succeeding Brian Smith.
Ballotpedia also lists him as an officeholder of the North Country Junior Union High School District 22 in Derby, with a term ending in 2026.
